name: Measure a slow UI interaction (targeted perf capture)
description: Drive a profile-mode performance capture of a scenario's UI and (optionally) a SPECIFIC interaction — a scroll, drag, or click/type sequence — so the trace spans the slow journey you are investigating. Returns a CDP trace + web-vitals; hand the trace to perf.analyze for React render/re-render (component-commit) attribution and LCP. The interaction is a bas/flows/<slug>.json marked intent:performance; omit --workflow for the default navigate+settle.

scenario.description: Scenario slug whose UI to capture.

flow.description: Perf-flow slug (<scenario>/bas/flows/<slug>.json, intent:performance) to drive a specific interaction. Empty = default navigate+settle.

outcome.description: captured | skipped (no UI) | unavailable (no browser/BAS) | failed.

trace_artifact.description: Path of the CDP trace; feed to perf.analyze.

examples.description: Trace a slow virtualized-list scroll in image-tools.
